name: Silvia
source:
Popular girl of the school and it’s idol. Silvia does her best to be a role model for the school and due to her family background, is a bit spoiled and somewhat vain, but is the reliable type and will see a task through till the end. Silvia isn’t the type to break the rules or disobey a direct order, making her an easy person for her teachers to trust. She’s someone who likes order and for people to be in the right place at the right time. Oddly she’s into dance and secretly wants to become a dancer, though her family would have it otherwise. Also, she’s a bit of a perfectionist.
